name: Adanero (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Adanero (a tower with a warrior on red above waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 29 December 1997 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 18 of 28 January 1998); the flag is described as a square flag of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in their colours at the centre.

features.role: Adanero arms — tower with warrior above waves
